claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, activate the service worker, go offline, reload, and use sample markers

claim: Demo sample data never reads or writes real markers
sandbox: create a real marker, enter /demo, change and reset demo data, then leave demo and verify the real marker
capture a demo marker while recording requests; assert same-origin GETs and the demo IndexedDB namespace

claim: Links are saved as references and the timer is manual
sandbox: set a demo link, assert it is retained as an href without fetching it, and advance the manual timer by 15 seconds
select a fixture WAV in demo, assert local playback, and assert all requests are same-origin GETs

claim: The app has no account or analytics
sandbox: use the demo without account fields while asserting every request is same-origin

claim: No payment or account is required
sandbox: open ?demo=1 and assert capture is enabled with no payment, upgrade, password, or checkout interface

claim: Captures a timestamp and typed takeaway
sandbox: fresh demo; advance the timer, enter a typed takeaway, save it, and assert the rendered timestamped marker

claim: Optional voice takeaways are stored in the browser without a network request
sandbox: fresh demo with a fixture MediaRecorder; save a voice blob, assert playable output in demo IndexedDB, and allow same-origin GETs only

claim: A marker can include a recall cue and check date
sandbox: fresh demo; save a typed marker with a cue and date, then assert both in the rendered marker and demo IndexedDB

claim: Review shows the cue before the takeaway and records the result
sandbox: fresh demo sample; open Review, assert the takeaway is hidden until Reveal, choose a result, and verify it in demo IndexedDB

claim: Exports markers as Markdown, CSV, and a complete JSON backup
sandbox: fresh demo sample; download all three formats and assert filenames plus expected marker fields and rows

claim: Imports a complete JSON marker backup
sandbox: fresh demo; import a valid fixture backup, confirm replacement, assert rendered data and verify real IndexedDB is untouched

claim: A typed takeaway remains available when voice recording is unsupported
sandbox: fresh demo with MediaRecorder and getUserMedia unavailable; assert the recovery message, then save a typed marker

claim: The app does not send media for remote processing
sandbox: fresh demo; select a local fixture and record a fixture voice note while asserting every request remains a same-origin GET

claim: A selected local media file is not restored after reload
where: local-file source note, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh demo; select a fixture WAV, reload, and assert its filename and media element are absent from DOM and storage

claim: Microphone permission is requested only after Record is pressed
sandbox: fresh demo with a getUserMedia spy; assert zero calls on load and editor open, then one call after Record

claim: Manage marker data can delete every marker
sandbox: fresh demo sample; accept the specific destructive confirmation, then assert an empty marker list and empty demo IndexedDB

claim: The app does not download, host, transcribe, or share source media
sandbox: fresh demo; open a fixture locally, assert same-origin requests and local playback, and assert no media transfer, transcription, or clip-sharing controls
